title: Giraffe waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f2b632'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='4' fill='#b57016'/>

  <circle cx='46' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#b57016'/>

  <rect x='30' y='80' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e0a028'/>

  <rect x='62' y='80' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f2b632'/>

  <rect x='29' y='92' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a18'/>

  <ellipse cx='74' cy='18' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2b632'/>

  <ellipse cx='84' cy='20' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8c78a'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a18'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a18'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='15' r='2.2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='74.7' cy='14.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <ellipse cx='64' cy='11' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e0a028' transform='rotate(-25 64 11)'/>

  <circle cx='69' cy='3' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a18'/>

  <circle cx='79' cy='3' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a18'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q72 50 80 36' stroke='#f2b632' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- hoof hand -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#8a5a18'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 68 Q14 64 16 74' stroke='#e0a028' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='76' r='3' fill='#8a5a18'/>
